# Victor Alvarado

> Senior Product Engineer portfolio and autobiographical site. Full-stack web and mobile products, practical AI integrations, case studies, and career history — built with Astro.

Victor Alvarado is a software engineer with 11+ years of experience shipping production systems for remote teams. He works across product engineering, Next.js/React/Astro development, Supabase/PostgreSQL backends, and AI-enabled workflows. This site is the canonical source for his background, project work, and contact information.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://victoralvarado.dev/): Overview, featured projects, and summary of skills and impact metrics.
- [About](https://victoralvarado.dev/about/): Extended biography, personal story, and professional focus areas.
- [Experience](https://victoralvarado.dev/work/): Career timeline with roles at Network Specialist Pro's, Beanario Software, PaperSoft, and Credito Solidario.
- [Projects](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/): Case studies covering fintech, e-commerce, mobile, and open-source work.
- [Education](https://victoralvarado.dev/education/): Academic and professional training background.

## Featured project case studies

- [RulesForAI](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/rules-fo-ai-case-study/): Platform that generates structured rules and skills for AI coding agents from natural-language project context.
- [BPFairValue](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/bpfairvalue/): Options trading platform with fair value pricing, premarket LOI, screener, and subscription onboarding.
- [The Closet Clique](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/theclosetclique/): Student fashion marketplace with marketing site and iOS app for verified school Cliques.
- [GloveSafe](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/glove-safe/): Headless Shopify storefront with custom bundle builder for baseball and softball glove accessories.
- [Speed Air Conditioning](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/speed-ac/): Next.js marketing site with Sanity CMS, multi-audience pages, and lead capture for a South Florida HVAC company.
- [React Simple Typewriter](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/react-simple-typewriter-vb/): Lightweight open-source React package for typewriter text effects with TypeScript and SSR support.
- [Simply Paper](https://victoralvarado.dev/projects/simplypaper/): Native Android wallpaper app — university project that led to first Android developer role.

## Work experience

- [Network Specialist Pro's — Senior Product Engineer](https://victoralvarado.dev/work/network-specialist-pros-2/): Leading product and engineering across customer-facing platforms and internal tools.
- [Network Specialist Pro's — Senior Full-Stack Engineer](https://victoralvarado.dev/work/network-specialist-pros/): Full-stack delivery across internal operations and customer-facing systems.
- [Beanario Software — Lead Frontend Engineer](https://victoralvarado.dev/work/beanaio/): Frontend delivery across fintech, mobile, and startup client projects.
- [PaperSoft — Full-Stack Developer](https://victoralvarado.dev/work/papersoft/): Public-sector platform for environmental compliance and business registration.
- [Credito Solidario — Web Developer](https://victoralvarado.dev/work/credito-solidario/): Financial inclusion tooling for credit access and reporting.
